name: View sagas
description: List sagas and open their detail, timeline and map without saga data, message payloads or error text; see children, correlations, saga types and the retry plan.

name: View saga data
description: See saga state, message payloads and error messages.

name: Retry sagas
description: Re-run the failed step of a failed or timed-out saga.

name: Manage access
description: Manage users, teams and roles. Counts only in a grant for all saga types.
